Justiciar Crusader is an Undead creature in Baldur's Gate 3. It is found in the Gauntlet of Shar.

Involvement

The Justiciar Crusader is a hostile entity that cannot be spoken to.

Similar to other Dark Justiciars in the Gauntlet of Shar, the Justiciar Crusader is summoned through an Umbral Tremor's  Permit Passage action. It can only be summoned by one specific tremor that spawns in at X: -820 Y: -786.
